blocking_findings.title: Swallowed mandatory deadline can be followed by successful read/refresh
blocking_findings.detail: read_latch_status catches Exception, including MandatoryGuardTimeout from the existing one-shot SIGALRM. Unlike baseline immediate refusal, candidate continues through another read/protected refresh. No absolute monotonic deadline or expired flag is rechecked; the one-shot alarm has already fired. The outer5s total bound therefore does not cover this recovery path reliably.
